item.title: Ariana Grande Announces Full ‘Petal’ Tracklist
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest music update. Ariana Grande fans, we've got exciting news for you. The tracklist for her upcoming album, Petal, has finally been confirmed.
[Short music transition]
Host: Grande revealed the full song set during her Eternal Sunshine Tour stop in Inglewood, California, on June 19th. She even shared a sneak peek of the unveiling on her Instagram after the show. The album's lead single, "Hate That I Made You Love Me", which debuted at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, is just one of the 12 tracks on the list.
[Short music transition]
Host: So, what can we expect from Petal? The album kicks off with "Kiss Me", followed by the hit single "Hate That I Made You Love Me", and the title track "Petal". Other notable tracks include "Big Feelings", "Freak", and the closer "Nowhere, Nobody". Petal is set to drop on July 31st, marking the follow-up to Grande's chart-topping album Eternal Sunshine.
[Short music transition]
Host: Here's a quick rundown of the tracklist:
1. "Kiss Me" 2. "Hate That I Made You Love Me" 3. "Petal" 4. "Stay" 5. "Oh Well" 6. "Big Feelings" 7. "Freak" 8. "(Warning Signs)" 9. "Like I Do" 10. "Never Get Over Me" 11. "Bad Thing (Bunny Hop)" 12. "Nowhere, Nobody"
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for now. Get ready to dive into Ariana Grande's Petal on July 31st. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next update.
